scope: Offline conditional role-presence check, not execution authorization; all new inputs authored, not measured real review completions. No LLM/data benchmark.
rule_change: v1 requires methods and implementation; v2 additionally requires data-steward when data_change=true.
arms: RDF data and actual SHACL conditional membership constraints compiled from JSON rules
precedence: unknown condition used by policy -> unknown
all required roles witnessed -> satisfied even partial
missing required role + complete coverage -> missing
missing required role + partial coverage -> unknown
limits: No approval state, distinct reviewer identity, current artifact binding, freshness or blocker checks
No live research runner gate change
No proof of RDF maintenance benefit; JSON and RDF share policy representation/compiler setup counted separately
Coded v1/v2 coexist, not measured sequential developer editing
No hidden source detection or automatic ontology learning
measurements: Full inputs, outputs and separate authored expectations
Source hashes and static setup footprint, not labor
Actual SHACL invocation and conformance versus preflight unknown
next: Integrate with existing binding/freshness checks only after explicitly defining composition and identifying useful evidence; do not repeat parity alone.
